text: The City seeks an implementation partner for Oracle ERP and Utility Billing deployment and integration

citations.text: The purpose of this request for proposal (RFP) is to invite qualified implementation partners to submit a proposal for the deployment and integration of Oracle's Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Utility Billing solutions for the City of Durham in North Carolina (the City).

text: City needs Oracle implementation expertise, especially utility billing, customer accounts, meter reading, and billing processes

citations.text: The City requires a partner with proven expertise in effectively implementing Oracle's solutions, particularly in areas critical to local government operations such as utility billing (including customer accounts management, meter reading, and customer billing processes).
